meaning.en: to feel better because a worry has gone
meaning.de: sich besser fühlen, weil eine Sorge weg ist

equivalent.tr: rahatlamak, içi rahat etmek, oh çekmek

usage.en: relieved (that) + clause · relieved to + verb (hear/see/know) · "What a relief!" · "That's a relief." · exclamation: "Phew!"
usage.tr: relieved (that) + cümle · relieved to + fiil (hear/see/know) · "What a relief!" · "That's a relief." · ünlem: "Phew!"

sentences.en: I'm so [relieved] the exam is over.
sentences.tr: Sınav bittiği için çok rahatladım.
sentences.de: Ich bin so erleichtert, dass die Prüfung vorbei ist.

sentences.en: Oh, thank God. What a [relief]!
sentences.tr: Oh, çok şükür. İçim rahatladı!
sentences.de: Oh, Gott sei Dank. Was für eine Erleichterung!

expressions.expr: a weight off one's shoulders / a load off one's mind

meaning.en: the lightness of being freed from a big worry
meaning.tr: büyük bir dertten kurtulmanın verdiği ferahlık
meaning.de: die Leichtigkeit, von einer großen Sorge befreit zu sein

equivalent.tr: omuzlarından yük kalkmak, içinden bir yük kalkmak
equivalent.de: jemandem fällt ein Stein vom Herzen, eine Last fällt von jemandem ab

literal.en: a weight lifted from the shoulders / a load taken from the mind; off = separation from the surface
literal.tr: omuzlardan kalkan ağırlık / zihinden inen yük; off = üstünden ayrılma

usage.en: It's/That's a (huge/real) weight off my shoulders · a load off my mind · take a weight off sb's shoulders
usage.tr: It's/That's a (huge/real) weight off my shoulders · a load off my mind · take a weight off sb's shoulders

sentences.en: Handing in my thesis was such [a weight off my shoulders].
sentences.tr: Tezimi teslim edince omuzlarımdan büyük bir yük kalktı.
sentences.de: Als ich meine Abschlussarbeit abgegeben habe, ist mir eine riesige Last von den Schultern gefallen.

sentences.en: Thanks for telling me — that's a real [load off my mind].
sentences.tr: Söylediğin için sağ ol, içim ferahladı.
sentences.de: Danke, dass du es mir gesagt hast – da fällt mir wirklich ein Stein vom Herzen.

meaning.en: to become calm / to make someone calm

usage.en: calm down (intransitive) · calm sb/yourself down (transitive, separable). Same pattern: cool down, settle down, quiet down.
usage.tr: calm down (geçişsiz) · calm sb/yourself down (geçişli, ayrılabilir). Aynı kalıp: cool down, settle down, quiet down.

note.en: Telling an angry person "Calm down!" usually has the opposite effect; it sounds dismissive.
note.tr: Kızgın birine "Calm down!" demek çoğu zaman tam ters etki yapar; küçümseyici algılanır.

sentences.en: Take a deep breath and [calm down].
sentences.tr: Derin bir nefes al ve sakinleş.
sentences.de: Atme tief durch und beruhige dich.

sentences.en: I went for a walk to [calm myself down].
sentences.tr: Sakinleşmek için yürüyüşe çıktım.
sentences.de: Ich bin spazieren gegangen, um mich zu beruhigen.

meaning.en: to relax, to be easy-going; to hang out

literal.en: chill = coolness (ANGER IS HEAT, CALM IS COLD)

usage.en: chill (out) · "Chill!" (calm down) · chill with sb = hang out · adjective: "He's really chill." = relaxed, easy-going
usage.tr: chill (out) · "Chill!" (sakin ol) · chill with sb = takılmak · sıfat: "He's really chill." = rahat, kafa biri

sentences.en: [Chill out], it's only five minutes late.
sentences.tr: Sakin ol, alt tarafı beş dakika gecikti.
sentences.de: Entspann dich, es sind nur fünf Minuten Verspätung.

sentences.en: I just want to [chill] at home this weekend.
sentences.tr: Bu hafta sonu sadece evde takılmak istiyorum.
sentences.de: Ich will dieses Wochenende einfach zu Hause chillen.

meaning.en: (1) to rest and not tire yourself (2) to stay calm and not react harshly
meaning.tr: (1) kendini yormamak, dinlenmek (2) sakin olmak, sert tepki vermemek
meaning.de: (1) sich ausruhen und schonen (2) ruhig bleiben und nicht heftig reagieren

equivalent.tr: kendini yorma, ağırdan al; sakin ol
equivalent.de: es ruhig angehen lassen; immer mit der Ruhe

variety.en: AmE + BrE (in AmE also a goodbye: "Take it easy!")
variety.tr: AmE + BrE (AmE'de veda sözü olarak da: "Take it easy!")

usage.en: take it easy (on sb = to be gentle with someone) · go easy on sb/sth
usage.tr: take it easy (on sb = birine yumuşak davranmak) · go easy on sb/sth

sentences.en: You've been working non-stop — [take it easy] this weekend.
sentences.tr: Hiç durmadan çalışıyorsun, bu hafta sonu biraz dinlen.
sentences.de: Du hast pausenlos gearbeitet – lass es dieses Wochenende ruhig angehen.

sentences.en: Hey, [take it easy]! I was only joking.
sentences.tr: Sakin ol ya! Sadece şaka yapıyordum.
sentences.de: Hey, immer mit der Ruhe! Das war nur ein Scherz.

meaning.en: to recover from (sadness, a breakup, an illness); to stop loving someone
meaning.de: sich von etwas erholen (Kummer, Trennung, Krankheit); aufhören, jemanden zu lieben

literal.en: to climb over to the other side

usage.en: get over sth/sb — inseparable: get over it ✓, ✗ get it over. "Get over it!" (harsh: move on already) · "I can't get over how…" = I still can't believe · get it over with = to do it quickly and be done (a different pattern)
usage.tr: get over sth/sb — ayrılmaz: get over it ✓, ✗ get it over. "Get over it!" (sert: aş artık şunu) · "I can't get over how…" = hâlâ inanamıyorum · get it over with = bir an önce yapıp kurtulmak (farklı kalıp)

sentences.en: It took me a year to [get over] the breakup.
sentences.tr: Ayrılığı atlatmam bir yıl sürdü.
sentences.de: Ich habe ein Jahr gebraucht, um über die Trennung hinwegzukommen.

sentences.en: I can't [get over] how much she's changed.
sentences.tr: Ne kadar değiştiğine hâlâ inanamıyorum.
sentences.de: Ich kann es nicht fassen, wie sehr sie sich verändert hat.

meaning.en: to drop a topic or a grievance; to stop dwelling on it
meaning.de: ein Thema oder einen Groll fallen lassen; nicht länger darüber grübeln

equivalent.de: es gut sein lassen, loslassen, etwas auf sich beruhen lassen

usage.en: let it/sth go · "Just let it go." · let go of sth (to release emotionally)
usage.tr: let it/sth go · "Just let it go." · let go of sth (duygusal olarak bırakmak)

sentences.en: It was a stupid comment. Just [let it go].
sentences.tr: Aptalca bir laftı. Boş ver gitsin.
sentences.de: Das war ein dummer Kommentar. Lass es einfach gut sein.

sentences.en: I know I should [let it go], but it still bothers me.
sentences.tr: Bırakmam gerektiğini biliyorum ama hâlâ içime oturuyor.
sentences.de: Ich weiß, ich sollte es gut sein lassen, aber es beschäftigt mich immer noch.

expressions.expr: pull oneself together / get it together

meaning.en: to get your emotions under control and recover
meaning.de: seine Gefühle wieder in den Griff bekommen und sich fangen

literal.en: to pull yourself together (gather the scattered pieces)
literal.tr: kendini bir araya çekmek (dağılmış parçaları toplamak)

usage.en: pull yourself together (for an emotional collapse in the moment) · get it together / get your act together (also for sorting your life out in general)
usage.tr: pull yourself together (o anki duygusal dağılma için) · get it together / get your act together (genel olarak hayatını düzene sokmak için de)

sentences.en: I cried for ten minutes, then [pulled myself together] and went back in.
sentences.tr: On dakika ağladım, sonra kendimi toparlayıp içeri döndüm.
sentences.de: Ich habe zehn Minuten geweint, mich dann zusammengerissen und bin wieder reingegangen.

sentences.en: Come on, [get it together] — we're on in five minutes.
sentences.tr: Hadi toparlan, beş dakikaya sahnedeyiz.
sentences.de: Komm, reiß dich zusammen – wir sind in fünf Minuten dran.

meaning.en: to say something you've been holding in and feel better
meaning.tr: içinde tuttuğu bir şeyi söyleyip rahatlamak
meaning.de: etwas aussprechen, das man in sich getragen hat, und sich danach besser fühlen

equivalent.de: sich etwas von der Seele reden, etwas loswerden

literal.en: to lift something off your chest

usage.en: get sth/it off your chest · "I need to get something off my chest."
usage.tr: get sth/it off your chest · "I need to get something off my chest."

sentences.en: Can I talk to you? I need to [get something off my chest].
sentences.tr: Konuşabilir miyiz? İçimde tuttuğum bir şeyi söylemem lazım.
sentences.de: Kann ich mit dir reden? Ich muss etwas loswerden.

sentences.en: I felt so much better after [getting it off my chest].
sentences.tr: İçimi döktükten sonra çok rahatladım.
sentences.de: Nachdem ich es mir von der Seele geredet hatte, ging es mir viel besser.

meaning.en: to relax gradually after a busy day or period
meaning.tr: yoğun bir günden/dönemden sonra yavaş yavaş gevşemek
meaning.de: nach einem anstrengenden Tag oder einer anstrengenden Phase langsam zur Ruhe kommen

literal.en: /waɪnd/ — a wound spring running down; un- = reversal, down = decrease
literal.tr: /waɪnd/ — kurulmuş yayın boşalması; un- = geri alma, down = azalma

usage.en: wind down (intransitive) · unwind (intransitive). Opposite: be wound up (tense).
usage.tr: wind down (geçişsiz) · unwind (geçişsiz). Karşıtı: be wound up (gergin, kurulmuş).

sentences.en: I usually watch something dumb to [wind down] after work.
sentences.tr: İşten sonra kafamı boşaltmak için genelde saçma bir şey izlerim.
sentences.de: Nach der Arbeit schaue ich meistens irgendetwas Dummes, um runterzukommen.

sentences.en: I need a few days to [unwind].
sentences.tr: Kafa dinlemek için birkaç güne ihtiyacım var.
sentences.de: Ich brauche ein paar Tage zum Abschalten.

equivalent.de: jemanden beruhigen, jemandem die Sorgen nehmen

literal.en: to put someone's mind in a state of ease

variety.en: AmE + BrE (BrE also: put sb's mind at rest)
variety.tr: AmE + BrE (BrE ayrıca: put sb's mind at rest)

usage.en: put/set sb's mind at ease · reassure sb (more formal synonym)
usage.tr: put/set sb's mind at ease · reassure sb (daha resmî eşanlamlı)

sentences.en: Just text me when you land — it'll [put my mind at ease].
sentences.tr: İnince bir mesaj at, içim rahat etsin.
sentences.de: Schreib mir einfach, wenn du gelandet bist – dann bin ich beruhigt.

sentences.en: The doctor really [put my mind at ease].
sentences.tr: Doktor gerçekten içimi rahatlattı.
sentences.de: Die Ärztin hat mich wirklich beruhigt.

meaning.en: to tell someone in a hard time "keep going, don't give up"
meaning.tr: zor bir dönemde birine "dayan, pes etme" demek
meaning.de: jemandem in einer schweren Zeit sagen: „Mach weiter, gib nicht auf“

literal.en: stay hanging on there, keep holding on
literal.tr: orada asılı kal, tutunmaya devam et

usage.en: Imperative, as comfort: "Hang in there." About yourself: "I'm hanging in there." = I'm coping.
usage.tr: Emir kipinde, teselli olarak: "Hang in there." Kendin için: "I'm hanging in there." = idare ediyorum.

sentences.en: [Hang in there] — only two more weeks until the holidays.
sentences.tr: Dayan, tatile sadece iki hafta kaldı.
sentences.de: Halt durch – nur noch zwei Wochen bis zu den Ferien.

sentences.en: I know it's tough right now, but [hang in there].
sentences.tr: Şu an zor biliyorum ama dayan.
sentences.de: Ich weiß, es ist gerade hart, aber halt durch.
